entry.author: Hawke's Bay Regional Council
entry.summary:
Proud to be a part of a community that cares for our environment 💚🌱

One of our focus areas as a regional council is promoting Land and Water Health. Creating opportunities for the community to get involved in environmental mahi is one of the ways we do this. 

📸 Footage from our recent Beach Clean-Up for Seaweek 2026
